UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Private user profile and discovery preferences for a CineFlix account.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the user owner.

email.description: User email address (isolated to owner read only).

bio.description: Short cinephile bio or profile tagline.

favoriteGenres.description: Bounded list of up to 10 preferred TMDB genre IDs.

autoplayTrailers.description: Whether trailers and streams autoplay on open.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the profile was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the profile was last updated.

WatchlistItem.title: WatchlistItem
WatchlistItem.description: A movie or TV series saved to a user's persistent My List watchlist.

userId.description: UID of the user who owns this watchlist entry.

tmdbId.description: TMDB numeric ID of the movie or TV show.

mediaType.description: Whether the title is a movie or tv series.

title.description: Display title of the movie or series.

posterPath.description: TMDB poster path or empty string.

backdropPath.description: TMDB backdrop path or empty string.

releaseDate.description: Release or first air date string.

genreIds.description: Bounded list of up to 10 TMDB genre IDs.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when added to watchlist.

ViewingHistoryItem.title: ViewingHistoryItem
ViewingHistoryItem.description: A movie or TV series watched by the user, used for Continue Watching and personalized TMDB recommendations.

userId.description: UID of the user who watched this title.

tmdbId.description: TMDB numeric ID of the movie or TV show.

mediaType.description: Whether the title is a movie or tv series.

title.description: Display title of the movie or series.

posterPath.description: TMDB poster path or empty string.

backdropPath.description: TMDB backdrop path or empty string.

releaseDate.description: Release or first air date string.

genreIds.description: Bounded list of up to 10 TMDB genre IDs.

seasonNumber.description: Season number for TV series (1 for movies).

episodeNumber.description: Episode number for TV series (1 for movies).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when playback progress was last updated.

/users/{userId}.description: Private user account profile and discovery preferences. Strictly isolated to owner.

/users/{userId}/watchlist/{itemId}.description: User's persistent cross-device My List watchlist items.

/users/{userId}/history/{itemId}.description: User's viewing history and playback progress used for personalized TMDB recommendations.
